observations.why: Directive issued in a settled, confident register — establishing cadence without urgency or alarm, conveying composed assurance.
Aphoristic framing carries urgency-as-worry: an unrehearsed rollback is framed as no rollback at all, injecting alarm into the rationale.
Summary framing in a settled, organizational register — recording decisions with composed finality, no heightened arousal.
